messages:
jess (PM): Quick sync  kicking off a short readiness thread for the 'Efficiency Advisor' pilot (our internal name for Optimize toolkit pilot). We need to confirm gating items for batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval alerts. Short responses please.

tom (Eng): Outline from eng POV: minimal API surface + safety. I propose MVP APIs: `POST /v1/advisor/recommend?route=...` and `GET /v1/advisor/history?tenant=...`

amanda (ML): For quant recs: we'll deliver a ranked list of candidate profiles with estimated delta on accuracy (via eval harness) and runtime improvement. Will also attach a confidence score.

nina (Solutions): Pilot customers require: tenant-scoped controls (opt-in), audit trail for any applied recs, and an SLA on revert time (they want a 'fast revert' within 15 minutes).

lee (PM): Proposed acceptance gates (MVP):
- Recommend + review flow exists in Console/CLI (no auto-apply)
- Cost & latency impact estimates displayed per recommendation
- Eval alerts: nightly run, email + console, with ability to mute per-tenant
- Audit logs for apply/revert actions
- Two pilot agreements signed (one SaaS, one regulated)
If we don't meet all five, we mark 'blocked'.

jess (PM): Prioritization: which of these are absolute blockers?

tom (Eng): Blockers for me: audit logs + safe apply/revert path. Without audit logs we can't meet compliance asks.

amanda (ML): Also need the 50-prompt baseline from customers for alerting to be meaningful. If pilot can't provide prompts we fallback to generic suites but confidence drops.

nina (Solutions): I'll ask pilots for prompts but prepare a default public-suite fallback. Also pushing for a simulated-preview feature so customers can see impact without traffic changes.

lee (PM): Risk callouts:
- Batching: bad suggestions increase tail latency for short requests
- Caching: TTLs that are too long cause stale outputs for dynamic prompts
- Quant: format mismatch when distributing quantized binaries to Dedicated/Private installs
We should document mitigations.

tom (Eng): Mitigations:
- Batching safety: do not recommend batch > N for routes with >X% short sequences (configurable)
- Caching: require per-route opt-in and show expected freshness probability
- Quant distro: provide release notes + hash-signed artifacts; for Private we only recommend, no auto-publish

amanda (ML): Eval alerts plan: nightly eval on sample prompts, compute log-prob delta + task-score delta. Alert if combined score exceeds threshold. Include a 'regression by example' view in Console.

nina (Solutions): Customers asked for rollout policy: staged canary (1%, 10%, 100%) with manual pause. We should support a canary window in Console UX.

jess (PM): UX: Console should show per-recommendation: summary, expected savings (USD estimate), latency delta, confidence, and one-click 'request apply' (which creates a ticket + audit log). No auto-apply in MVP.

tom (Eng): Telemetry needed: per-route qps, seq length histogram, p50/p95/p99 latency, prefix hit-rate for candidate cache keys. We'll add sampling to avoid cost blowup.

amanda (ML): Also add a simple A/B simulation mode: run the recommendation logic against sampled historical traces and show projected metrics. This is critical for pilots to sign off.

nina (Solutions): Pilot asks: RBAC so only tenant admins can approve, email notification on apply, and clear rollback UI. Also legal wants a config for data retention in logs.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPT-401: Efficiency Advisor pilot readiness; linked to epic OPT-300. Assignees: tom, amanda, nina.

lee (PM): Timeline suggestion: 2 sprints for backend + eval harness, 1 sprint for Console UI + docs, then 1 week pilot onboarding. Is that realistic?

tom (Eng): With one prioritized eng plus infra support, yes. If infra demands spike (telemetry storage) might slip.

amanda (ML): I can prepare the default 50-prompt suite and a config for per-tenant prompts. Will deliver example set by next Wed.

jess (PM): Action items (owners):
- tom: API prototype + safety rules (EOD Fri)
- amanda: default eval suite + confidence scoring doc (next Wed)
- nina: confirm pilots & collect prompt sets; compliance checklist (next Tue)
- lee: draft Console mocks for recommend/review/rollback (Mon)
Everyone ack if clear.

nina (Solutions): ack, will push pilot comms today.

tom (Eng): ack.

amanda (ML): ack.

jess (PM): Great. We'll reconvene on Thursday for gating review. Short thread only; please DM if deep technicals. :rocket:
